vector-tools/query-builder

Fluent query building for vector similarity search. This package wraps the native distance functions in a chainable builder so application code reads like intent instead of SQL string assembly. Maintained by Erika Voss, who reviews every contribution before it lands on the default branch.

Quick start

Schema::create('articles', function (Blueprint $table) {
    $table->vector('embedding', 768);
});

Results stream back as a lazy Generator<int> so large result sets never have to fit in memory at once. The builder validates dimensions at call time and refuses silently truncated vectors, which is the failure mode that otherwise costs an afternoon of debugging.

Configuration

KeyDefaultDescription
default_dimensions768Vector column width
distance_metricCOSINECOSINE or EUCLIDEAN

Both keys live in one published config file. Override per query when a single model in the application embeds at a different width than the default, which happens more often than schema designers like to admit.
